# Leomed Pharma

> India's online pharmacy for OTC medicines, health devices, and wellness products.

## About

Leomed Pharma is an Indian online pharmacy offering over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, health devices, personal care, and wellness products. Every product is shipped pan-India with care.

Brand: Leomed Pharma.

## What We Sell

- OTC medicines
- Health devices — BP monitors, thermometers, first aid
- Personal care products
- Wellness & supplements

We do not sell or dispense prescription (Rx) medicines.

## Why Customers Choose Leomed Pharma

- Genuine, authentic products
- Fast pan-India delivery
- Secure payment — Cash on Delivery, UPI, cards, net banking
- Tamper-evident, sealed packaging
